comment: Dr. Pierce was an amazing professor that cared a lot about his students and would always go out of his way to make sure you understood what you were learning. This is a hard class, but he knows it and tries to make it reasonable at the same time.

I never studied or cared about this class and got an A. It is manageable if you study and use your time wisely, however, I never did and it worked out for the best. I wanted to fall asleep during every biology lecture, but I also despise the subject.

Dr. Pierce is the best Bio professor I've ever had. He loves teaching, and he will make sure you succeed in life. He is a very understanding and amazing advisor for the lab. His lectures are very interactive and helpful. Just beware that he doesn't give extra credit opportunities. Overall, he's an amazing professor.

Incredible professor. Can't say enough good things about this guy. If you make an effort you will succeed. Decent amount of work but a very easy class overall. Cares so much about his students and wants to see everyone thrive. Take this class without a doubt.
He is a great lab professor, makes you laugh, and does not keep you the whole time. Would take if you get the chance.
Amazing professor. He is extremely caring towards his students and passionate about what he teaches. Knows when to offer extra credit. You can turn in any work late if you need to.

Dr. Pierce is a caring and awesome instructor. His lectures are engaging and relevant, and he is very accessible outside of class. Tests can be tricky, but are always reasonable (especially if you study). A great professor and I hope to have him again at UR.

Dr. Pierce is an AMAZING person and a very good teacher. He makes the subject very interesting and easy to understand and is always there to support you if you have any problems. He is very kind and understanding. He also addresses the social issues by building their connection to science. If you have a chance to take his class, don't miss it!!!

This teacher is the most kind man. He is a very easy grader, he is completely understanding, and he is so easy-going. I wouldn't say I enjoyed taking Synthetic Biology, but Dr. Pierce made it worth while. I never take the time to rate my professors, but I can't not say anything. He is too kind of a man, and too kind of a teacher.

Dr. Pierce is a phenomenal educator who is amazing at making the material he teaches understandable for everyone. He worked with monks, teaching them fundamental biology. With that being said, he is able to relate to the most brilliant mind in the room as well as the slacker missing class.  He just has an amazing ability to keep you engaged.
